name: Bird Dog
instructions: Kneel on all fours, hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Brace your stomach and reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back until both are level with your body.
Hold for 2 seconds without letting your hips rotate.
Return slowly and switch sides. Reps are per side.

name: Thread the Needle
instructions: Start on all fours.
Slide one arm under your body along the floor, letting your shoulder and head drop toward the mat.
Reverse the motion and reach that arm up toward the ceiling, following it with your eyes.
Move slowly through the full range. Reps are per side.

name: Open Book
instructions: Lie on your side with knees bent to 90 degrees and arms straight out in front, palms together.
Keep your knees together and sweep your top arm up and over to the other side, rotating your upper back.
Pause when your arm is as close to the floor as is comfortable, then return.
Reps are per side.

name: Couch Stretch
instructions: Kneel with one knee close to a wall or bench and that shin running up it.
Step the other foot forward into a lunge.
Squeeze the glute of the back leg and lift your chest until you feel a stretch at the front of the hip.
Hold, breathing slowly, then switch sides.

name: Pigeon Stretch
instructions: From all fours, bring one knee forward behind your wrist and angle that shin across your body.
Extend the other leg straight back.
Keep your hips square and lower your chest toward the floor until you feel the stretch in the front-leg glute.
Hold, then switch sides.

name: Sphinx Stretch
instructions: Lie face down with elbows under your shoulders and forearms on the floor.
Press up gently, lifting your chest while your hips stay down.
Relax your lower back and glutes and breathe slowly.
Hold, then lower down.

name: Seated Figure-4 Stretch
instructions: Sit near the front of a chair with both feet flat.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Keep your back long and lean forward from the hips until you feel the stretch in the crossed-leg glute.
Hold, then switch sides.

name: Desk Hamstring Hinge
instructions: Stand facing a desk and place both hands on its edge.
Step back and hinge at the hips, keeping your back flat and arms straight.
Let your chest sink until you feel the stretch along the backs of your legs and under your arms.
Hold, breathing slowly.

name: Seated Thoracic Rotation
instructions: Sit tall with feet flat and arms crossed over your chest.
Keep your hips still and rotate your upper body to one side as far as is comfortable.
Return to the middle and rotate to the other side.
Reps are per side.

name: Chin Tucks
instructions: Sit or stand tall, looking straight ahead.
Glide your head straight back, making a double chin, without tilting it up or down.
Hold for 2 seconds, then relax.

name: Standing Back Extension
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hands on your lower back.
Gently lean back, opening your chest and keeping your knees soft.
Return to standing. Keep the range small and comfortable.

name: 90/90 Hip Switches
instructions: Sit on the floor with both knees bent to 90 degrees, one leg in front and one to the side.
Keep your chest tall and rotate both knees to the other side so the legs swap positions.
Move slowly and use your hands behind you for support if needed.
Reps are per side.

name: Wall Slides
instructions: Stand with your back and head against a wall, arms in a "W" with elbows and wrists touching the wall.
Slide your arms up into a "Y" while keeping contact with the wall.
Slide back down, squeezing your shoulder blades together.

name: Air Bike Intervals
instructions: Warm up for 2 minutes at an easy pace.
Alternate 20 seconds hard with 40 seconds easy.
Keep the hard efforts strong but controlled.

name: Burpees
instructions: Squat down and place your hands on the floor.
Jump or step your feet back into a plank.
Jump or step your feet back in, then stand and jump up.

name: Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Stand with feet a little wider than hips and the kettlebell slightly in front.
Hinge, grip it with both hands and hike it back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward to swing it to chest height, arms relaxed.
Let it fall back into the next hinge. Keep your back flat throughout.

name: Farmer Carry
instructions: Pick up a heavy dumbbell or kettlebell in each hand.
Stand tall with shoulders down and stomach braced.
Walk 20 to 30 metres with short, steady steps. Each length is one rep.

name: Dead Hang
instructions: Grip a pull-up bar with hands shoulder-width apart.
Lift your feet and hang with arms straight and shoulders relaxed.
Breathe slowly. Step down before your grip gives out.
